name: Aldren Synth-Cotton Slim Chino
description: Trim-cut chinos in a synth-cotton twill that breathes well in M88's humid summers and holds a crease without ironing. Available in a range of muted tones — stone, bark, slate, olive. A clean, unfussy pant that reads professional without reading corporate.
materials: recycled nylon reinforcement at seat and knees
functionality: Mild wrinkle resistance; retains crease shape for 8–10 hours of wear
what_it_says: You present yourself well without making a fuss about it. Reliable, measured, probably holds a regular job.
story_hooks: The 'slate' colorway is subtly identical to a decommissioned municipal inspector uniform — opens certain doors by accident.
A Tier 4 contact judges someone for wearing these to a meeting; the wearer uses the slight to their advantage.
